name: Gopeshwar–Ukhimath National Highway
significance: NH 107A is a branch of NH 107. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Gopeshwar to Ukhimath, and it meets NH 107 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 107 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Rudraprayag to Kedarnath
